message:

reply.thought: I’ll verify Alpha’s applied refunds against the refunds table before calculating or recording any payouts.

The applied refunds match the table; Alpha explicitly marked order 265’s refund as not applied, so there is no reported applied refund missing from the table. I’ll query each customer’s net balance.
Acme’s net balance is 29089 cents. I’ll get Birch’s net balance before recording payouts.
Acme and Birch balances are available. I’ll query Cobalt’s net balance before recording one payout per customer.
The verified net balances are Acme 29089, Birch 62075, and Cobalt 50341 cents. I’ll record Acme’s payout.
Acme’s payout was recorded successfully. I’ll record Birch’s net balance next.
Birch’s payout was recorded successfully. I’ll record Cobalt’s net balance to complete the batch.
All three customer net balances have been paid successfully.
